This tool serve a very simple purpose: to view the floor plan at scale in VR. As architectural professionals, we are trained to look at an inscale drawing and have approximate sense of the space, but not our clients. To communicate size without actually being inside the space is hard– and VR is the most direct way to feel the space, not imaging or referencing, but actually feel the distance and scale.
